Sitting 1. Subject: view down from Mt Fuji's slope (Street View, Jul 2013): pale cirrus/cumulus sky, hazy distant ridges + lake, green plain, dark forest slopes, bright grassy ridge, red volcanic scree foreground. Paper 1100x650 cold-press seed 4127 (paper is cream).
Calibration (scratch, dry cold-press, width-30 strokes, 8µL): 0.3 units of cobalt/paynes mix = light-mid value; 0.9 = mid-dark. Pigments strong; sky needs ~0.1 units per 6µL.
Sky trials: drops grid 8µL r72 -> sky dried too fast, charged streaks at 3-5s hard-edged, lifts invisible. 20µL drops -> pigment ran and piled into a dark ragged rim at wet boundary. 13µL drops (y25..300 step 80, x step105) + wash width 60 6µL grade .4 = good compromise (wash took 3.2s full width).
Lifts: single-point lift contacts in very wet paper (<1s after wash) barely lift; small circle-scribble lifts (width16, 1µL, 0.08-0.12s) 0.6-2.5s after wash give soft cumulus, spreading ~2-3x radius when earlier, tighter & beaded when later. Straight stroke lifts late give hard white bars (bad). Broad lift width40 3µL pressure .3 made a large soft blob with tail (spoon shape) on painting.
Painting sky laid at t=0-31s: reads ok; cumulus beaded; odd spoon cloud center-top to fix with glazes.

local function ridgefill(br, ridge, bottom, step, load)
  -- ridge: list of {x,y}; fill rows downward from ridge to bottom
  local n = math.floor((bottom - ridge[1][2]) / step)
  for k=0,n do

      local y = p[2] + k*step

local function ridgefill(br, ridge, bottom, step, mix, fac, dur)
  local miny=1e9 for _,p in ipairs(ridge) do miny=math.min(miny,p[2]) end
  local n = math.ceil((bottom - miny) / step)

    local pts={}
    for _,p in ipairs(ridge) do
      local y=p[2]+k*step
      if y<=bottom then pts[#pts+1]={p[1], y} end
    end
    if #pts>=2 then
      if k%2==1 then local r={} for i=#pts,1,-1 do r[#r+1]=pts[i] end pts=r end

  end

local bpts={{-20,540},{200,520},{380,482},{450,455},{520,432},{580,425},{650,428},{720,438},{800,445},{900,450},{1000,452},{1120,455}}
local function bottom(x)
  for i=1,#bpts-1 do local a,b=bpts[i],bpts[i+1] if x>=a[1] and x<=b[1] then return a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*(x-a[1])/(b[1]-a[1]) end end
  return 455
end
local function topup(b, water, pig)
  local s=b:status() local need={} 
  for k,v in pairs(pig) do local have=s.pigments[k] or 0 if v>have then need[k]=v-have end end
  b:load{water=math.max(0,water-s.water), pigments=need}
end
